name: power_efuse_usb
title: HeyPCB USB eFuse - 5 V inline protection, 2 A limit, 6.1 V clamp, TPS259251
brief: USB 5 V eFuse: USB-C in, a TPS259251 eFuse limiting current to about 2 A, clamping the output at 6.1 V and riding out a 20 V input, soft start and auto-retry, output on a 5 mm screw terminal with a TVS and a green LED; 26 x 30 mm, 2 layers.

netClasses.name: PWR
netClasses.why: about 2 A at the limit; the 2 A paths are carried in board.zones, 0.8 mm is the target for the entries into the VSON's 0.5 mm-pitch pins

rules.why_min_track: Freerouting necks into the VSON-10's 0.5 mm-pitch pins; JLCPCB 2-layer builds 0.127 mm

board.notes: 2 layers: F.Cu signal + GND pour, B.Cu signal + GND pour, both poured after routing.

zones.name: vusb
zones.why: the receptacle's VBUS pins to the input cap and the eFuse's three VIN pins: up to 2 A. On F.Cu and B.Cu, stitched: the receptacle's GND pins sit 0.8 mm from its VBUS pins and their routed tracks cut a top-layer strip (measured: VBUS reached the eFuse by one 0.2 mm, 12 mm track)

zones.name: vout
zones.why: the eFuse's three OUT pins and the output cap up to the terminal's + pin, and down to the TVS: up to 2 A

usb:J?.why: USB-C plugs in from the left edge

out:J?.why: output wires leave the right edge, straight across from the receptacle

fuse:U?.why: eFuse mid-board: VIN pins (3-5) lower left toward the receptacle, OUT pins (6-8) lower right toward the terminal, control pins on its upper half

fuse:C1?.why: input cap left of the VIN pins, VUSB pad (1) up in the VUSB zone, 1.25 mm clear of the eFuse

fuse:C2?.why: output cap right of the OUT pins, VOUT pad (1) up in the VOUT zone, below the terminal's courtyard

fuse:R2?.why: ILIM resistor above the eFuse's ILIM pin (10, upper right), out of the VOUT zone and clear of the spot left of the terminal where its - mark goes

out:D?.why: output TVS below the terminal, clear of the output cap, VOUT pad at the top facing the VOUT zone

led:R?.why: output LED below the eFuse, out of both power zones

fuse:C3?.why: soft-start cap above the eFuse, by dV/dT (pin 1, upper left), out of both power zones

switches.why: + at the terminal pin on VOUT, - at GND

captions.place_3d: USB-C on the left edge, the TPS259251 eFuse in the middle, the output terminal on the right edge.
captions.done_3d: TPS259251 5 V eFuse: 2 A current limit, 6.1 V output clamp, soft start, screw-terminal output with TVS and LED.
